recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-15787; handle FHIR-55302 separately if and when that terminology migration enters application scope.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification PA change request, raised in STU3 and applied for R5, asking to add a qualification subclass at the Organization resource level like Practitioner.qualification. The resolution also asked to broaden Practitioner qualification wording and add Organization certification/qualification wording covering official certifications, accreditations, training, designations, and licenses.
initial_application: Historical source commits 3e775cb876a78287feb0e2f68b369aae9cf352b0 and eeb6c58711daf1fa23102f3f2426327333e57bd0 added Organization.qualification and updated the Organization identifier search parameter to include Organization.qualification.identifier. Commit 59f25a099c07759b6ab65c4ac1287ef30fd0ba6f updated Practitioner.qualification wording in the same application window for related Practitioner issues, satisfying the Practitioner wording portion of the FHIR-15787 resolution.
additional_context: Organization is active and approved in source/fhir.ini. Later FHIR-34375 work, already separately represented on the combined branch, refined the shared qualification model by adding Organization.qualification.status and period semantics. Later FHIR-55302 proposes a THO terminology migration but is only Resolved - change required and does not supersede this Applied/Published seed. Community searches found no conflicting direct evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current Organization StructureDefinition already defines Organization.qualification 0..* with the requested wording and expected children, and the Organization identifier search parameter already includes qualification identifiers.

related_jiras.note: Updated Practitioner.qualification wording in the same application window, supporting the Practitioner wording part of FHIR-15787's resolution.
Clarified Practitioner qualification versus PractitionerRole specialty and was applied in the same commit as the Practitioner wording update.
Added qualification.status and period semantics to Practitioner and Organization; already represented by a separate issue-reconcile commit on the combined branch.
Later Resolved - change required Organization issue to move qualification-status terminology to THO; background only for this default Applied/Published seed.
US NDH issue confirms organization qualifications remain relevant in that IG context but does not require a FHIR core source change.
